name: fullstack-app
description: A full-stack Lean app (a REST server and a Lasm.UI browser app), compiled to WebAssembly by Lasm

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:workers: npm run build:client && lasm build Workers.lean --target workers
scripts.build:bun: npm run build:client && lasm build Export.lean --target bun
scripts.build:deno: npm run build:client && lasm build Deno.lean --target deno
